answer: The gale index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1656 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the canyon. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the violet queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 10 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
